Record Class EraChangedEvent

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.common.messages.events.game.EraChangedEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Event, GameEvent, Message, Serializable
public record EraChangedEvent(Era newEra, List<String> newUpperRowBuildings, List<String> newLowerRowBuildings, List<String> discardedBuildings) extends Record implements GameEvent
Notifies all players that the game has entered a new era and the building market changed.
